sourceFile: 05. BRS-161016  Report test VP happen NG different color- date 27.05.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but mis-pairs several test rows with the wrong normal rows and includes a questionable header-only measurement outcome.
issues: Primary change should be test VP different color lot vs normal VP, not a broad condition list.
Second-date laser, VP/CD, and function comparisons use prior normal rows instead of same date/line normal rows.
Outcome comparison row lists omit required paired normal rows Test!23, Test!36, and Test!52.
Measurement-2 appears derived from a header or non-comparable row and should not be final evidence.
Tension sample counts/grouping need verification against the five reported values per row.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to test VP different color lot IR250520007 versus normal VP molds.
Pair each test row with the adjacent normal row sharing the same date, line, section, and context.
Add Test!23, Test!36, and Test!52 to the relevant outcome evidence and recompute deltas.
Remove Measurement-2 unless actual data rows support it.
Verify tension grouping and sample counts, then judge as pass/same normal if supported.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are incomplete and one cited row is questionable.
